text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 detected — elevated 503s from inference fleet in eu-west-1. Pagering oncall: @ryan. Automated alert: error-rate spike > 15% on generation API. Creating war room and collecting initial diagnostics.
ryan: I'm oncall and joining. Pls post war room link and scope.
incident-bot: War room created: https://warroom.redwood.internal/room/INC-2026-001 (zoom + slack huddle). Logs aggregation: https://logs.redwood.internal/q/INC-2026-001
maria: I'll draft customer-facing text and post to statuspage after we agree. Tentative owner for comms: @maria. @jen can you stand by for legal/PR review if needed?
ryan: Owner for mitigation is me. Initial triage: several model-serving pods hitting OOM and returning 503s around 09:23 UTC. Rolling restarts attempted, some pods flapping. Starting a targeted restart on shard-2 hosts now.
luis: Kicking off node drain + restart on affected ASG. Running:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -l shard=2 -o wide
kubectl cordon node/ip-10-0-2-45
kubectl drain node/ip-10-0-2-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
# note: autoscaler will add capacity after drain
```
anika: If restarts don't stabilize within 5m, recommend temporary routing policy to shift eu-west traffic to eu-north until capacity is healthy. Routing change ETA ~3-4m and requires approval from @ryan.
maria: Draft statuspage entry (please review): "We are investigating elevated 503 responses for text-generation requests in eu-west-1. Impact: some requests are receiving 503 errors or elevated latency. Mitigation: we are restarting affected nodes and may temporarily shift traffic. No customer data exposure detected. Next update in 15 minutes or when we have more info." Add or edit please.
jen: LGTM — add a retry note and support contact. Suggest: "Customers seeing errors should retry; contact support@redwood.com for persistent failures."
ryan: Applied restart batch. Logs show OOM originating from the model shard loader; increasing replica count for shard-2 by 2 as an immediate mitigation. Commands used:
```
kubectl scale deploy/infer-shard-2 -n inference --replicas=6
# monitor pods: kubectl rollout status deploy/infer-shard-2 -n inference
```
incident-bot: Statuspage draft created: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026-001 (private draft). Will publish on approval.
maria: Publishing customer note now: "We are investigating elevated 503 responses for inference in eu-west-1. Engineers are actively mitigating; retrying requests may help. We'll update within 15 minutes." Posted to statuspage and support channel. (copy sent to #support-notify)
luis: Restart completed on nodes ip-10-0-2-45/47/49. Error rate dropping from ~22% -> ~4% over last 6 minutes. Monitoring graphs: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/graphs?panel=503-rate&range=10m
ryan: Gradually shifting traffic back and watching KPIs (error rate, p95 latency). If stable for 30m we'll declare mitigation and start RCA. Taking ownership of on-call action; @maria to lead postmortem/customer follow-up.
anika: Noted. I'll capture routing decision timeline and rollback plan for the postmortem.
maria: Acknowledged — postmortem owner. I'll collect timelines, config diffs, and customer communication artifacts. Planning an internal postmortem doc and a short external blurb once we have RCA.
jen: Thanks all. If anything needs escalation to support tier-2 or legal, ping me. Otherwise hold updates to 15m cadence unless new impact.
ryan: Thanks team — continuing to monitor in war room. Closing updates here once stable for 30m. :white_check_mark:
